summary.text: Brandon Ler is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 33 and has served as Speaker of the House since January 2025; he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner and former school board member, he was first elected to the House in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Ler was born in Sidney, Montana, and graduated from Sidney High School in 2005.
He was an entrepreneur and the owner of the fencing company Double L Fencing, and he served six years on the Savage School District Board of Education.

Ler was first elected to the House in 2020 to represent District 35, defeating incumbent Republican Joel Krautter in the primary by 53 percent to 47 percent and running unopposed in the general election.
He won re-election in 2022 in District 35, and in 2024 he defeated Kathy Hoiland in District 33.
In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the House Ethics Committee and is assigned to the House Taxation, Human Services, and Business and Labor committees.
